_readme: GitHub Copilot usage-based (per-token) billing, in effect since 2026-06-01. 1 AI credit = $0.01 USD. Source: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/models-and-pricing (checked 2026-10-13). Keys under "models" must match the "<providerID>/<modelID>" strings found in session exports.
_assumptions: reasoning tokens priced at the output rate (GitHub does not list them separately). Claude Haiku 5.5 uses the default tier (<=100K input tokens); its long-context tier (>100K: input 0.50, cached 0.05, cache write 0.625, output 2.50) is not modelled. Multipliers are 0: premium-request multipliers apply only to legacy annual plans and do not list 5.5 models, so est_premium_requests is meaningless; use est_usd.
_billing_unit: Only affects est_premium_requests (legacy). per_llm_call: every LLM request (step-finish) costs `multiplier`. per_user_prompt: every user message in any session of the tree costs `multiplier`.
